RNA_seq_method_verbatim: RNA extraction from samples that had been stored at −80°C, library preparation, and sequencing of paired-end 150 nt reads were performed as described previously (15). RNA-seq reads were aligned to the GRCh38 genome assembly using STAR (RRID: SCR_004463, v2.7.10b). Gene-level quantification was performed by RSEM (RRID: SCR_013027, v1.3.3) based on the Ensemble gene model (GRCh38.104). Only samples with at least 5 million uniquely mapped reads (range, 5.1–154, median 25.4) in total were included in the study (Supplementary Table S1).
